run_k400_preprocess: run the kinetics 400 dataset preprocessing script to generate a CSV of video paths and class indices
run_k400_preprocess_custom_split: run the kinetics 400 preprocessing with a custom split directory and mode via CLI arguments
create_k400_csv: create a CSV file mapping Kinetics-400 video file paths to their class indices from a dataset directory
review_k400_preproces: review the k400_preproces function that scans dataset directories and writes class-indexed CSV output
refactor_k400_preproces: refactor the k400_preproces function to support additional dataset formats or output options
